import cadquery as cq

def build(p):
    Ro = p.disk_d/2 + p.box_wall
    Ri = p.disk_d/2
    base = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(Ro).extrude(p.base_t)
    wall = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(Ro).circle(Ri).extrude(p.box_depth)
    box = base.union(wall)

    hr = p.disk_holes_c_c/2
    boss_d = p.m3_head_d + 6
    boss = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(boss_d/2).extrude(p.box_depth - p.base_t)
    for x in (-hr, hr):
        box = box.union(boss.translate((x,0,p.base_t)))

    pilot = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.m3_pilot_d/2).extrude(p.box_depth - p.base_t - 2)
    for x in (-hr, hr):
        box = box.cut(pilot.translate((x,0,p.base_t + 2)))

    sd = p.perf_corner_hole_d + 4.5
    ix = p.perf_corner_hole_inset
    px = [-p.perf_l/2 + ix, p.perf_l/2 - ix]
    py = [-p.perf_w/2 + ix, p.perf_w/2 - ix]
    stall = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(sd/2).extrude(p.perf_standoff_h)
    for sx in px:
        for sy in py:
            box = box.union(stall.translate((sx,sy,p.base_t)))

    spilot = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.m3_pilot_d/2).extrude(p.perf_standoff_h - 3)
    for sx in px:
        for sy in py:
            box = box.cut(spilot.translate((sx,sy,p.base_t + 3)))

    slot = cq.Workplane('XZ').rect(p.usbc_w, p.usbc_h).extrude(4*p.box_wall)
    box = box.cut(slot.translate((Ro, 0, p.usbc_z)))

    return box
